Implemented the Codex empty-response fix.

- Preserves accumulated text deltas when `response.completed` contains no output.
- Falls back to `response.output_text.done` when deltas are omitted.
- Applies equivalent fallback behavior to streaming responses.
- Added regression tests in [codex_test.go](/private/tmp/luban-agent-benchmark-work/repos/danielmiessler__Fabric-2098/codex/internal/plugins/ai/codex/codex_test.go).

Validation: `gofmt` and `git diff --check` pass. Go tests could not run because the offline environment lacks Go 1.25.1 and the toolchain manager attempted to download it.
